description: OpenRouter returns 403 both for forbidden requests (guardrail blocks, missing permission) and when a moderated model flags the input: `{ error: { code: 403, message: "... your input was flagged ...", metadata: { reasons, flagged_input, provider_name, model_slug } } }`. The spec only declares a generic 403, so moderation failures get their own ModerationFlagged class on the inference operations, matched by the flagged message or the presence of `error.metadata.flagged_input` (both more specific than the bare 403 Forbidden matcher). It carries no httpError so it is not categorised as an auth error. Source: https://openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference/errors (ModerationErrorMetadata), fetched 2026-10-05. Each `*Stream` sibling has its own `errors` list, so the stream operations are patched explicitly (asserted in src/response-validation.test.ts).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The selected model requires moderation and the input was flagged. `error.metadata` carries `reasons`, `flagged_input`, `provider_name` and `model_slug`.
